title: The Bubbling Pitch Pit
story: At the edge of the ember fields, Glomdrake the Pitch Swallower burps hot tar into a stone pit — and three lantern-crabs are stranded on a ledge above it. The pit already holds 6 gallons of tar, and it takes 42 gallons to reach the ledge. Mr 6 organizes a bucket brigade while he does the math.
question: Tar seeps in at 7 gallons per minute and the bucket brigade hauls out 4 gallons per minute. How many minutes until the tar reaches the ledge?
solution: The pit still needs 42 - 6 = 36 more gallons before the tar touches the ledge.
The tar really rises by 7 - 4 = 3 gallons each minute.
praise: Subtracting the brigade's buckets to get the real rise rate is the heart of this puzzle — the one step missed was that 6 gallons of tar were already in the pit.
hint: Two things to settle first: how many gallons are still needed, and how much the tar GAINS each minute once the buckets fight back.
victory: With 12 minutes on the clock, Mr 6 calmly builds a rope sling and lifts all three lantern-crabs out with four minutes to spare. Glomdrake, left burping into an empty pit, sulks off to find a quieter puddle.
imagePrompt: A glossy black tar pit bubbling in an ember-lit wasteland, a huge slow pitch beast burping ooze while a small numeral '6' knight directs a bucket brigade beneath a ledge of glowing lantern-crabs, tense orange firelight.
